transcript.answer: The web UI opens one WebSocket per browser tab to lore-api at `/api/ws` (configured via `LORE_WS_URL`, i.e. `wss://<lore-api host>/api/ws`). It sends JSON text frames and multiplexes named channels over that one connection. The `run` channel forwards an assembly run's pod events and transcript. Access to it uses a token minted by `POST /api/assembly-runs/{id}/stream-token`, stored in `lore.live_tokens` with a sha256 hash and a 10-minute TTL. The `plan` channel tunnels the plan editor's Hocuspocus collaboration bytes to the same collab server, and the collab-token handshake stays inside the tunnel. The web-ui keeps the socket in a provider above every page, so going from a plan to its run keeps the connection. On the server there is one feed per run, fed by Postgres NOTIFY, so N viewers cost one re-read per notification. This replaced the earlier SSE stream (ADR-037) in ADR-048 and PR #2122, dated 2026-09-23. The SSE route, the `EventSource` hook and the web-ui proxy hop were removed.
